mechanism.chainConfirmed: unStake transfers LP into the release contract. LP then vests progressively across the selected 30/60/90-day period; release() transfers the currently vested LP back, and the full amount is vested by the end of the period.
mechanism.importantCorrection: The SENTIS value in the unstake event is the fee valuation basis, not a fixed SENTIS payout.
mechanism.burnTwoPercentStatus: unresolved: frontend text claims a 2% burn, but it is not yet safe to model as a second final-payout deduction. LP, SENTIS fee transfers and Synox transfers are reported separately.
